title: The Sims Medieval
notes: Reviewed community evidence; not a complete playthrough verification.

reviewedUserReports.notes: Exact clean IPA tested on POCO ARM64. It reached the main menu, character selection, 3D character creation, name and kingdom entry, and the live outdoor world. A held touch changed the character appearance; the world camera zoom and horizontal drag changed the visible scene. In-game pause, Save and quit, the populated character slot and loading back to the world worked, including after force-stopping and cold relaunching the emulator. Very brief synthetic ADB taps sometimes missed the character-selection button while 300 ms holds worked; this does not prove a real-finger input defect. Character walking, quests, audible music, frame pacing, longer play and emulator save states remain unverified. Repeated old advertising/server requests fail, but they did not block this path. Partial, not a full-playthrough claim.
